<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Implements serialization with a default key derivation method.

Description: The `Other` class is created to handle serialization tasks, specifically setting the default key derivation method to "hmac". This class is instantiated when serialization processes require a specific key derivation strategy, ensuring consistency and security in data handling.

Attributes:
    default_key_derivation (str): Sets the default key derivation method to "hmac". This attribute is set during initialization and is used throughout the class to ensure all serialization processes adhere to this default strategy.
</DOCSTRING>
